title: Analysts' Recent Ratings Changes for Finisar
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Mar 26th, 2018 // No Comments 
Several analysts have recently updated their ratings and price targets for Finisar (NASDAQ: FNSR): 3/10/2018 – Finisar was given a new $23.00 price target on by analysts at Barclays. They now have a “hold” rating on the stock. 3/9/2018 – Finisar was given a new $15.00 price target on by analysts at Goldman Sachs. They now have a “sell” rating on the stock. 3/9/2018 – Finisar was downgraded by analysts at Needham & Company LLC from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating. They now have a $29.41 price target on the stock, up previously from $16.64. 3/9/2018 – Finisar is now covered by analysts at Morgan Stanley. They set an “equal weight” rating and a $21.00 price target on the stock. 3/9/2018 – Finisar had its “buy” rating reaffirmed by analysts at DA Davidson. They now have a $22.00 price target on the stock, down previously from $24.00. 3/9/2018 – Finisar had its “buy” rating reaffirmed by analysts at B. Riley. They now have a $17.50 price target on the stock, down previously from $18.00. 3/9/2018 – Finisar had its price target lowered by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus from $24.00 to $22.00. They now have a “buy” rating on the stock. 3/7/2018 – Finisar was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a “strong sell” rating to a “sell” rating. 3/5/2018 – Finisar had its “outperform” rating reaffirmed by analysts at Raymond James Financial. 3/5/2018 – Finisar was downgraded by analysts at UBS from a “strong-buy” rating to an “outperform” rating. 3/5/2018 – Finisar had its “buy” rating reaffirmed by analysts at William Blair. They wrote, “We expect the company to come in roughly in line on revenue with a downward bias to EPS due to ongoing datacom pricing pressure affecting gross margin. The Street is looking for $333 million on revenue (roughly flat sequentially) and $0.23 for EPS; we are in line on revenue and a penny below consensus on EPS. We believe the company could see modest quarter-over-quarter expansion in 3-D sensing (revenue is relatively small to be affected by recent Apple [AAPL $176.21; Not Rated] iPhoneX cuts) offsetting ongoing inventory correction in China (at Huawei and ZTE) and product transition at hyperscale customers (Amazon [AMZN $1,500.25; Outperform] transitioning from 40G to 100G). The biggest risk to Finisar remains gross margins, which could remain pressured until datacom pricing stabilizes, cost reduction products become available, and/or higher-margin products (CFP2-ACO and ROADMs) begin to ship in volume.”” 3/1/2018 – Finisar had its price target lowered by analysts at B. Riley from $20.00 to $18.00. They now have a “buy” rating on the stock. 2/26/2018 – Finisar had its price target lowered by analysts at Loop Capital from $19.00 to $17.00. They now have a “hold” rating on the stock. 2/8/2018 – Finisar was upgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating. According to Zacks, “FINISAR CORP. is a provider of fiber optic subsystems and network test and monitoring systems which enable high-speed data communications over local area networks, or LANs, storage area networks, or SANs, and metropolitan access networks, or MANs. They are focused on the application of digital fiber optics to provide aline of high-performance, reliable, value-added optical subsystems for data networking and storage equipment manufacturers. “ 2/2/2018 – Finisar was downgraded by analysts at ValuEngine from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating. 1/29/2018 – Finisar was downgraded by analysts at Piper Jaffray from an “overweight” rating to a “neutral” rating. 1/29/2018 – Finisar is now covered by analysts at Loop Capital. They set a “hold” rating and a $19.00 price target on the stock. 1/25/2018 – Finisar was upgraded by analysts at ValuEngine from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating. 
Finisar Co. ( NASDAQ:FNSR ) traded down $0.28 during midday trading on Monday, reaching $16.01. The company had a trading volume of 2,048,600 shares, compared to its average volume of 4,390,079. The firm has a market cap of $1,868.38, a PE ratio of 18.62, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 2.47 and a beta of 1.02. Finisar Co. has a 12 month low of $15.99 and a 12 month high of $29.07. The company has a quick ratio of 3.24, a current ratio of 4.06 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.29. Get Finisar Co alerts: 
Finisar (NASDAQ:FNSR) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, March 8th. The technology company reported $0.20 earnings per share for the quarter, missing analysts’ consensus estimates of $0.23 by ($0.03). Finisar had a return on equity of 5.97% and a net margin of 7.35%. The business had revenue of $332.40 million during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $333.15 million. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $0.59 EPS. The business’s revenue for the quarter was down 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts anticipate that Finisar Co. will post 0.47 EPS for the current fiscal year. In other Finisar news, Director Jerry S. Rawls sold 30,209 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, February 1st. The stock was sold at an average price of $17.94, for a total transaction of $541,949.46. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this hyperlink . 1.02% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders. 
Several hedge funds have recently bought and sold shares of FNSR. Alliancebernstein L.P. grew its position in Finisar by 1,459.2% in the fourth quarter. Alliancebernstein L.P. now owns 3,152,517 shares of the technology company’s stock worth $64,154,000 after acquiring an additional 2,950,327 shares during the period. Franklin Resources Inc. purchased a new position in shares of Finisar during the fourth quarter worth $30,515,000. Pinnacle Associates Ltd. purchased a new position in shares of Finisar during the third quarter worth $28,033,000. Glenmede Trust Co. NA boosted its position in shares of Finisar by 3,941.8% during the fourth quarter. Glenmede Trust Co. NA now owns 825,578 shares of the technology company’s stock worth $16,799,000 after buying an additional 805,152 shares during the period. Finally, Royce & Associates LP boosted its position in shares of Finisar by 664.0% during the fourth quarter. Royce & Associates LP now owns 610,400 shares of the technology company’s stock worth $12,422,000 after buying an additional 530,500 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 93.46% of the company’s stock. 
Finisar Corporation (Finisar) is a provider of optical subsystems and components that are used in data communication and telecommunication applications. The Company’s optical subsystems consist of transmitters, receivers, transceivers, transponders and active optical cables, which provide the fundamental optical-electrical or optoelectronic interface for interconnecting the electronic equipment used in these networks, including the switches, routers, and servers used in wireline networks.
